lines.en: label rindorm35:
I knock on Rin’s door and wait to hear if there’s a response.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Rin 的门，等着听里面有没有回应。

lines.en: She was doing a lot better the last time I saw her, so I’m hoping that things have all but healed by now.
lines.zh: 上次见她的时候她已经好多了，所以我希望现在差不多都好起来了。

lines.en: One of the good things about Rin is that she makes it very apparent whenever she’s down.
lines.zh: Rin 的好处之一，是她心情低落的时候表现得特别明显。

lines.en: And I mean {i}very{/i} apparent.
lines.zh: 我是说，{i}非常{/i}明显。

lines.en: You’ve seen her. You know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: 你见过她的。你知道我在说什么。

lines.en: I knock again when there’s no response.
lines.zh: 没得到回应，我又敲了一次。

lines.en: : Hey, are you in there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你在里面吗？

lines.en: : I’m bored.
lines.zh: : 我好无聊啊。

lines.en: : Door’s open, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 门开着，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
Having received Rin’s blessing, I prepare myself for whatever lies within her room.
lines.zh: 得到 Rin 的许可后，我做好了面对房间里一切状况的准备。

lines.en: Which version of her will I see today?
lines.zh: 今天会见到她的哪一面呢？

lines.en: scene ringlow1
: Yo.
Ah. I see I’ve stumbled upon the broken one once again.
lines.zh: 啊。看来我又撞见那个坏掉的版本了。

lines.en: I feel like it’s lasted a little longer this time, but at least she hasn’t slipped into another state of delirium.
lines.zh: 感觉这次持续得久了一点，但至少她没有再陷入那种神志不清的状态。

lines.en: : How are you feeling?
lines.zh: : 你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Me? Oh, you know...Tired. Sad. Hungry. Bored.
lines.zh: : 我吗？哦，你知道的……累。难过。饿。无聊。

lines.en: : Well hopefully I can make at least one of those go away.
lines.zh: : 那希望我至少能解决掉其中一个。

lines.en: : Did you bring food? I feel like the hunger issue would be the easiest to solve.
lines.zh: : 你带吃的了吗？我觉得饿这件事最好解决。

lines.en: : I regret to inform you that I do not have any food.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾地通知你，我没有带吃的。

lines.en: scene ringlow2
: Damn. Back to the drawing board it is, then.
lines.zh: : 靠。那就另想办法吧。

lines.en: : We could always go out to eat if you want.
lines.zh: : 你要是想的话，我们也可以出去吃。

lines.en: : What, you mean looking like this?
lines.zh: : 什么，你说就我这副样子？

lines.en: : News flash but I look like a cross between a zombie and a serial killer.
lines.zh: : 告诉你吧，我现在看起来就像丧尸和连环杀手的混合体。

lines.en: : Serial killers aren’t normally this cute.
lines.zh: : 连环杀手可没这么可爱。

lines.en: : They’re not normally this hungry either. What with all the bodies they eat and stuff.
lines.zh: : 他们也没这么饿啊。毕竟还要吃尸体什么的。

lines.en: : Not all serial killers eat their victims, Rin.
lines.zh: : 不是所有连环杀手都吃受害者的，Rin。

lines.en: : No, but the best ones do.
lines.zh: : 是，但最厉害的那些会吃。

lines.en: scene ringlow1
: What would you do with your victims if you were a serial killer, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果你是连环杀手，你会怎么处置受害者？

lines.en: : What would I do?
lines.zh: : 我会怎么做？

lines.en: : Yeah. Like your signature. They’ve all got one.
lines.zh: : 对啊。比如你的招牌手法。他们都有自己的一套。

lines.en: : I...haven’t really thought about it before.
lines.zh: : 我……以前还真没想过。

lines.en: : If I ever started killing people, I think my trademark would be something involving tongues.
lines.zh: : 如果我哪天开始杀人，我觉得我的标志应该跟舌头有关。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’ve put so much thought into it.
lines.zh: : 很高兴你在这上面花了这么多心思。

lines.en: scene ringlow3
: Think about it, though. The tongue has so many uses. It’s an underrated muscle.
lines.zh: : 不过你想想。舌头用处可多了。这是块被低估的肌肉。

lines.en: : You need it to speak...to taste. Plus, you can use it sexually. There’s no other part of your body that can do all three of those things.
lines.zh: : 说话需要它……品尝也需要它。而且，还可以用在性上面。你身上没有别的部位能同时干这三件事。

lines.en: Okay, maybe Rin {i}has{/i} slipped into delirium again.
lines.zh: 好吧，也许 Rin 又有点神志不清了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定你没事吗？

lines.en: : No. But I haven’t hurt myself today, so at least there’s that.
lines.zh: : 不确定。但我今天没有伤害自己，所以至少还有这一点。

lines.en: : Well...that’s definitely a start.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那肯定是个好的开始。

lines.en: scene ringlow2
: Yeah...I’m getting there, though. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过我在慢慢好起来了。我能感觉到。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I’m even able to make it a full hour without thinking about her if I try hard enough.
lines.zh: : 有时候，只要我足够努力，甚至能撑整整一个小时不去想她。

lines.en: : Is she still texting you?
lines.zh: : 她还在给你发短信吗？

lines.en: scene ringlow4
: Yeah...I’ve been trying to keep my phone off as much as possible so I won’t have to deal with it, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过我尽量少碰手机，这样就不用去面对那些了。

lines.en: : And you haven’t even thought about, you know, actually {i}talking{/i} to her?
lines.zh: : 那你有没有想过，就是……真的跟她{i}谈谈{/i}？

lines.en: : Of course I’ve thought about it. But despite how I may seem to you, I’m not really one of those go-getter types.
lines.zh: : 我当然想过了。但别看我这样，我其实不是那种主动出击的人。

lines.en: : I’m actually a huge coward.
lines.zh: : 我其实是个大怂包。

lines.en: : I don’t like facing my problems when it’s easier to just lock myself in my room and wait for them to go away.
lines.zh: : 既然把自己锁在房间里等麻烦自己消失更省事，我就不想去面对问题。

lines.en: : Downside is that those problems always have a way of catching up to you in the end. But it is what it is.
lines.zh: : 坏处是那些麻烦最后总会追上你。但事情就是这样。

lines.en: : I’ll just stay here all sad, hungry, tired, and bored or whatever.
lines.zh: : 那我就继续在这儿待着，难过、饿、累、无聊什么的。

lines.en: : Until you have to come out, that is.
lines.zh: : 直到你不得不出门为止，是吧。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
scene ringlow5
: Oh, speaking of which.
lines.zh: : 哦，说起这个。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking a little more about that...post-heartbreak trip and...
lines.zh: : 我最近又想了想那次……失恋之后的出行，然后……

lines.en: : Well, I think it might be best if I do...explore a little.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得我最好还是……出去探索一下。

lines.en: : ...Are you coming onto me right now?
lines.zh: : ……你现在是在勾引我吗？

lines.en: : I know you’re normally into girls but, if you really want to-
lines.zh: : 我知道你平时喜欢女生，但如果你真的想——

lines.en: scene ringlow6
: I meant like, physically explore.
lines.zh: : 我是说身体上的，出去走走。

lines.en: : Oh, so purely sexual? Yeah, then-
lines.zh: : 哦，所以纯粹是性方面的？那——

lines.en: : Like purely {i}exploring{/i}.
lines.zh: : 是纯粹的{i}探索{/i}。

lines.en: : I want to go somewhere with you. Futaba too, if she’s free.
lines.zh: : 我想跟你去个地方。Futaba 有空的话也叫上。

lines.en: : There’s a part of the city that I haven’t been to in a while.
lines.zh: : 城里有个地方我很久没去了。

lines.en: : It’s a little closer to my old middle school than the [high_school], so there hasn’t been much reason for me to go over there as of late.
lines.zh: : 那里离我以前的初中比 [high_school] 近一些，所以最近没什么理由往那边跑。

lines.en: : But hey, change of pace and blah blah blah.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，换个节奏什么的。

lines.en: : You’re actually ready to start going out again?
lines.zh: : 你真的准备好要重新出门了？

lines.en: scene ringlow1
: Probably not. But I’ll do my best to make myself look normal again so I can survive in the outside world for a few hours.
lines.zh: : 大概没有。但我会尽量让自己看起来正常一点，好在外面的世界里撑上几个小时。

lines.en: : Besides, maybe I’ll find something out there that’ll help take my mind off of stuff a little better.
lines.zh: : 再说，说不定在外面能找到点让我更容易不去想那些事的东西。

lines.en: : Like...a new guitar or something.
lines.zh: : 比如……一把新吉他什么的。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll come out with you. Any idea when you’d want to go?
lines.zh: : 好。我陪你去。你想什么时候去？

lines.en: : Haruka’s been pretty flexible with my hours lately, so how about we meet up at the cafe over the weekend?
lines.zh: : Haruka 最近对我的排班挺宽松的，要不我们周末在咖啡厅碰头？

lines.en: : Even when I’m not working, I tend to show up there to grab coffee.
lines.zh: : 就算不上班，我也总喜欢去那儿买咖啡。

lines.en: scene ringlow2
: Though, I haven’t really had the motivation to do that lately...
lines.zh: : 不过最近实在没什么动力去了……

lines.en: : Sure. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 行。就这么说定了。

lines.en: It looks like Rin and I will be going out on an excursion the next time I show up at the cafe in the morning.
lines.zh: 看来下次我早上出现在咖啡厅时，就要和 Rin 一起出门远征了。

lines.en: From the sound of it, I think it might wind up taking all day.
lines.zh: 听起来，搞不好要花上一整天。

lines.en: I should probably clear up my schedule and be ready for that in the near future...
lines.zh: 我大概得把日程空出来，为不久后的那天做好准备……

lines.en: $ rininvite = True
else:
scene ringlow1
: Yeah...but I think I’ve figured out a way to do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……但我想我已经找到办法了。

lines.en: : I’m going to...go out exploring soon.
lines.zh: : 我打算……很快出去探索一下。

lines.en: : Look for some things that might help me feel normal again.
lines.zh: : 去找一些可能让我重新感觉正常起来的东西。

lines.en: : Maybe...try out new guitars or something.
lines.zh: : 也许……试试新吉他什么的。

lines.en: : You should bring Futaba along. The two of you might have some fun if you spend the day out doing...whatever girls do.
lines.zh: : 你应该把 Futaba 也带上。你们俩出去玩一天，做点……女孩子爱做的事，说不定会挺开心的。

lines.en: : It’s the same thing as whatever guys do, just cuter.
lines.zh: : 跟男生做的事一样，只是更可爱一点。

lines.en: : Then yeah, that.
lines.zh: : 那就这么办吧。

lines.en: : By the way, what are you watching?
lines.zh: : 对了，你在看什么？

lines.en: scene ringlow2
: Hm? This? Just some music thingy. It helps calm me down.
lines.zh: : 嗯？这个？就一个音乐什么的。能让我平静下来。

lines.en: : Most of the music I listen to is super angry and depressing, so hearing stuff like this is a big change of pace.
lines.zh: : 我平时听的音乐大多都特别愤怒、特别丧，所以听这种东西算是很大的调剂。

lines.en: : What’s the point of listening to angry and depressing music anyway? I never understood that.
lines.zh: : 那听愤怒又丧的音乐有什么意义？我一直不懂。

lines.en: scene ringlow1
: It’s nice knowing that other people out there share the same level of misery as me.
lines.zh: : 知道外面还有人跟我一样惨，感觉挺好的。

lines.en: : So...you’re basically cheering yourself up by hearing about how other peoples’ problems are worse than yours?
lines.zh: : 所以……你基本上是靠听别人的问题比自己更糟来让自己开心？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. But it’s a little more than that.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，嗯。但也不止这些。

lines.en: : It’s like...validation. Or something.
lines.zh: : 有点像……认同感。之类的。

lines.en: : Like, I’m still a [teenage]girl. We’re the prime demographic for overreacting and blowing things out of proportion.
lines.zh: : 就好比，我还是个 [teenage]女孩。我们这种人最容易反应过度、把事情无限放大。

lines.en: : So I’m kind of designed to feel like this at times.
lines.zh: : 所以有时候我会这样，也算是我这个年纪的设定。

lines.en: : But then again, so is everybody. You know?
lines.zh: : 但话说回来，大家其实都一样。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Why listen to happy music when it’s probably just fake?
lines.zh: : 既然快乐大概率是假的，那干嘛还要听快乐的音乐？

lines.en: : Real life is like, 90%% bullshit and 10%% actual good stuff. You know that, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 现实生活大概就是 90%% 的狗屁加 10%% 真正的好东西。这个你懂的吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, it makes a lot more sense when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这么一说就清楚多了。

lines.en: : I’m just having trouble understanding how sadness is somehow able to make sadness go away.
lines.zh: : 我只是不太明白，悲伤怎么能治好悲伤。

lines.en: scene ringlow7
: It’s not really easy to explain...It just does.
lines.zh: : 这个不太好解释……它就是能。

lines.en: : But not all the time. Hence the chill lofi girl.
lines.zh: : 但也不是每次都管用。所以才需要这个让人放松的 lofi 女孩。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Well, whatever works for you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，管用的话就行吧，我想。

lines.en: scene ringlow8
: Pro-tip, though...The next time you come to my room to try and cheer me up, bring a box of doughnuts or a cheeseburger.
lines.zh: : 不过给你个忠告……下次你来我房间想让我开心起来的时候，带一盒甜甜圈或者一个芝士汉堡来。

lines.en: : Those have pretty much the same effect on me as an angsty pop punk album, but with more flavor and less ex-girlfriends.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿对我的效果跟一张丧了吧唧的流行朋克专辑差不多，但更有味道，还不用牵扯前女友。

lines.en: : I don’t fully understand, but I’ll definitely stop somewhere and get you a cheeseburger the next time I have to go into damage-control mode.
lines.zh: : 我不太懂，但下次要进入「损害控制」模式的时候，我肯定会在路上给你买个芝士汉堡。

lines.en: scene ringlow1
: Heh...damage control is a good way of putting it.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……损害控制，这说法挺贴切的。

lines.en: : Between you and Futaba, I’ve barely had any time to feel sad at all.
lines.zh: : 有你和 Futaba 在，我几乎都没什么时间难过了。

lines.en: : You guys are ruining my normal strategy of sitting on my bed and staring at the wall for hours on end.
lines.zh: : 你们俩把我「坐在床上盯着墙看上几个小时」的常规操作给毁了。

lines.en: scene ringlow9
: Now, if only you two knew a way to get me to stop dreaming...
lines.zh: : 现在，要是你们俩能让我不做梦就好了……

lines.en: : What do you mean by-
lines.zh: : 你这话是什么意思——

lines.en: scene ringlow10
A sudden knock on the door interrupts my train of thought as both Rin and I find ourselves staring at it.
lines.zh: 一阵突然的敲门声打断了我的思绪，Rin 和我都不约而同地盯着那扇门。

lines.en: : Expecting someone?
lines.zh: : 你在等人？

lines.en: : I don’t think so?...
lines.zh: : 应该没有吧？……

lines.en: : Maybe Futaba saw you come in and she's just...being a good friend and making sure she’s not interrupting anything?
lines.zh: : 会不会是 Futaba 看见你进来了，就……出于好朋友的关心，来确认一下没打扰到什么？

lines.en: : I don’t think Futaba believes that anything like that is going on between us...
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Futaba 不会相信我们之间会有什么的……

lines.en: : Door’s open. You can come in.
lines.zh: : 门开着。你可以进来。

lines.en: : I’m not wearing pants, though. Hope that's cool.
lines.zh: : 不过我没穿裤子。希望你不介意。

lines.en: scene ringlow11
: Excuse me...
lines.zh: : 打扰了……

lines.en: scene ringlow12
: Wait...what are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 等等……你怎么会在这儿？

lines.en: : Damage control.
lines.zh: : 损害控制。

lines.en: : What are {i}you{/i} doing here?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}怎么会在这儿？

lines.en: scene ringlow13
: I...still don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 我……也不太清楚。

lines.en: : It’s hard to say.
lines.zh: : 很难说。

lines.en: scene ringlow14
: Do you think you could leave the two of us alone for a little while?
lines.zh: : 你能不能让我们俩单独待一会儿？

lines.en: : There’s something I want to talk to Rin about.
lines.zh: : 我有些话想跟 Rin 说。

lines.en: : Wait...Sensei...don’t-
lines.zh: : 等等……Sensei……别——

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll let you two talk.
lines.zh: : 好。那你们俩聊。

lines.en: scene ringlow15
: {i}Wait a minute!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等一下！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t want you to go!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不想让你走！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m not ready for this...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还没准备好……{/i}

lines.en: : Then make yourself ready.
lines.zh: : 那就让自己准备好。

lines.en: : You said it earlier. Problems always have a way of catching back up to you if all you do is hide from them.
lines.zh: : 你刚才自己说的。要是只会一味地躲，麻烦最后总会追上你。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : I’m going. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我要走了。别担心。

lines.en: : {i}Please...don’t...{/i}
scene black
: Have a good night, you two.
lines.zh: : 祝你们俩今晚愉快。

lines.en: Neither of them say another word to me as I make my way out of the room.
lines.zh: 我走出房间的时候，她们谁都没再跟我说一句话。

lines.en: But I’ve overstayed my welcome anyway.
lines.zh: 不过反正我也待得够久了。

lines.en: Rin’s been hiding from Chika ever since the beach, but has only just now run out of places to go.
lines.zh: Rin 从海边回来后就一直在躲着 Chika，可现在她已经无处可躲了。

lines.en: I’m not sure what’s going to happen in there.
lines.zh: 我不确定接下来在里面会发生什么。

lines.en: All I can hope is that something good comes of it...
lines.zh: 我唯一能指望的，是能有个好结果……

lines.en: $ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene ringlow16
: Hey...
: What...do you want?
lines.zh: : 你……想干什么？

lines.en: : Just to talk for a little while.
lines.zh: : 就想跟你聊聊。

lines.en: : You haven’t been answering my texts and I’ve been worried about you.
lines.zh: : 你一直不回我短信，我很担心你。

lines.en: : But, why?...
lines.zh: : 可是，为什么？……

lines.en: scene ringlow17
: Because you’re my friend...
lines.zh: : 因为你是我的朋友啊……

lines.en: : And {i}look{/i} at you. This isn’t the Rin I know.
lines.zh: : 而且你{i}看看{/i}你。这不是我认识的 Rin。

lines.en: : The Rin I know is bubbly and full of life and would never look like this.
lines.zh: : 我认识的 Rin 活泼开朗、充满活力，绝不会是这副样子。

lines.en: scene ringlow18
: That’s not true...I look like this all the time.
lines.zh: : 才不是……我一直都是这副样子。

lines.en: : I just always hid it from you because...yeah.
lines.zh: : 只是一直瞒着你，因为……嗯。

lines.en: : If you think your feelings are something you need to dance around, you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得自己的感情需要绕来绕去地藏着，那你就错了。

lines.en: scene ringlow19
: Huh?
: I know that my reaction when you told me probably wasn’t the best...but it’s not like I thought it was weird.
lines.zh: : 我知道你跟我告白的时候，我的反应可能不太好……但我并不觉得那很奇怪。

lines.en: : I just...I don’t know. It never occurred to me that you felt that way.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我不知道。我从没想过你是那种感觉。

lines.en: : And besides, I always kind of thought my first confession would have been from a boy, so...that was a bit of a shocker.
lines.zh: : 而且，我总觉得自己第一次被告白应该会是个男孩子，所以……有点受惊。

lines.en: scene ringlow20
: I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 对不起……

lines.en: : Stop apologizing. You didn’t do anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 别道歉了。你没做错什么。

lines.en: : I’ve felt like an asshole ever since you told me. I still can't believe I wasn’t able to say anything back then.
lines.zh: : 从你跟我说了以后，我一直觉得自己是个混蛋。到现在都不敢相信我当时居然什么都没说。

lines.en: scene ringlow21
: But...I’m going to say something now.
lines.zh: : 但是……我现在要说点什么。

lines.en: : And I want you to pay very close attention because it’s really important.
lines.zh: : 而且我要你认真听好，因为这件事很重要。

lines.en: : What...are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你……在干什么？

lines.en: scene ringlow22
: Rin Rokuhara.
lines.zh: : Rin Rokuhara。

lines.en: : I can not be in a relationship with you.
lines.zh: : 我不能和你交往。

lines.en: : My heart belongs to someone else.
lines.zh: : 我的心属于另一个人。

lines.en: : But just because I don’t feel the same way about you doesn’t mean that the two of us need to stop spending time together.
lines.zh: : 但我对你没有同样的感觉，不代表我们俩就不能再一起玩了。

lines.en: : In fact, you are hereby obligated to spend time with me because you’re my friend and I love you.
lines.zh: : 事实上，你现在被我强制要求陪我，因为你是我的朋友，我爱你。

lines.en: scene ringlow23
: And...if I refuse?
lines.zh: : 那……如果我拒绝呢？

lines.en: : I know where you live.
lines.zh: : 我知道你住哪儿。

lines.en: : And there’s no bathroom in here so I will literally sit outside of your room until you are forced to come out.
lines.zh: : 而且这儿没有洗手间，所以我会真的坐在你房间外面，直到你不得不出来为止。

lines.en: : This doesn’t seem very fair...
lines.zh: : 这好像不太公平……

lines.en: scene ringlow24
: What’s not fair is how you haven’t even been giving me the time of day lately.
lines.zh: : 不公平的是你最近连一点时间都不肯给我。

lines.en: : I didn’t want to just show up here without giving you the proper heads up, but you really didn’t leave me any choice.
lines.zh: : 我也不想不打招呼就跑来，可你真的没给我别的选择。

lines.en: : I was embarrassed...leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得丢脸……别管我了。

lines.en: scene ringlow23
: No. I refuse.
lines.zh: : 不。我拒绝。

lines.en: : Chika...
lines.zh: : Chika……

lines.en: : You really don’t have to do this, you know...
lines.zh: : 你真的不用做到这一步的，你知道吧……

lines.en: : I can only imagine how awkward it must be.
lines.zh: : 我能想象那有多尴尬。

lines.en: : It really doesn’t bother me. I swear.
lines.zh: : 我真的不介意。我发誓。

lines.en: : And I’ll try to be more conscious of it in the future.
lines.zh: : 而且以后我会注意一点的。

lines.en: : I’m sure there were a few things I said on our vacation that were easy to misinterpret, and I’m sorry for all of them.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定度假的时候我说过一些容易被误解的话，那些我都道歉。

lines.en: : But again, just because I can’t accept your confession doesn’t mean I don’t still want to see you all the time.
lines.zh: : 但再说一遍，我不能接受你的告白，不代表我不想时时刻刻见到你。

lines.en: : So please, for the love of God, stop ignoring me.
lines.zh: : 所以拜托，看在老天爷的份上，别再不理我了。

lines.en: scene ringlow25
: Life goes on. I know that better than most.
lines.zh: : 日子总要过下去。这一点我比大多数人都清楚。

lines.en: : We’ll figure this out together. Got it?
lines.zh: : 我们一起想办法。好吗？

lines.en: : Can you...maybe not touch me, though?
lines.zh: : 不过……你能不能别碰我？

lines.en: : Like, I’m all for it, but yeah...
lines.zh: : 就是，我其实挺想的，但是嘛……

lines.en: scene ringlow26
: Oh, shoot! I wasn’t even thinking! I’m so sorry!
lines.zh: : 啊，糟了！我完全没意识到！对不起对不起！

lines.en: scene ringlow27
: Heheh...hahahaha! It’s fine...it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……哈哈哈！没事……没事的。

lines.en: : Of course you’d react that way...
lines.zh: : 你当然是这种反应啦……

lines.en: scene ringlow28
: Thank you for properly rejecting me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，好好地拒绝了我。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for running off and not giving you the chance to in the first place.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我跑了，当初没给你这个机会。

lines.en: : It may have been your first confession, but it was my first time confessing {i}to{/i} anyone. Soooo...that was pretty nerve-wracking.
lines.zh: : 那可能是你第一次被告白，但也是我第一次{i}向{/i}别人告白。所以……真的紧张死了。

lines.en: : But...I’ll try my best to move on for both of our sakes...
lines.zh: : 但是……为了我们两个人，我会努力往前看的……

lines.en: : Just don’t hate me if I can’t get over you, okay? It’s been...kind of a long time, so it’s sort of ingrained into me now.
lines.zh: : 只是如果我还是忘不掉你，别讨厌我，好吗？毕竟……已经过去挺久了，这种感觉早就刻进我骨子里了。

lines.en: : Of course...take all the time you need.
lines.zh: : 当然……你想用多久就用多久。

lines.en: : I might not be the best person to actually talk to {i}about{/i} that with, but you’ve got Futaba and Sensei to air out your worries to whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 我也许不是最适合聊这些的人，但你随时可以找 Futaba 和 Sensei 倾诉。

lines.en: : I do...They’ve been a big help these last few days.
lines.zh: : 我知道……这几天他们帮了很大的忙。

lines.en: : They’re good people. And so are you.
lines.zh: : 他们都是好人。你也是。

lines.en: : Just try not to let this get you down. You mean a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 只是别让这件事把你打倒。你对我来说很重要。

lines.en: : You mean a lot to me too.
lines.zh: : 你对我来说也很重要。

lines.en: : And not just because I’m in love with you.
lines.zh: : 而且不只是因为我爱着你。

lines.en: scene ringlow29
: I know that, idiot...
lines.zh: : 我知道啦，笨蛋……

lines.en: : I’ll get out of your hair now. I just...wanted to say that everything is going to be okay. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 那我就不打扰你了。我只是……想告诉你，一切都会好起来的。就这些。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Thank you, Chika.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Chika。

lines.en: : I was nervous when you came in, but...this really did help.
lines.zh: : 你进来的时候我很紧张，但是……这真的帮了我很多。

lines.en: : Then my job here is done.
lines.zh: : 那我的任务就完成了。

lines.en: scene black
: Have a good night, Rin!
lines.zh: : 晚安，Rin！

lines.en: : Feel free to come knock on my door if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 有什么需要的话，随时来敲我的门。

lines.en: : Mhm...
: Goodnight, Chika...
lines.zh: : 晚安，Chika……

lines.en: {i}Life moves on!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}生活还要继续！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Live every day as if it’s your last!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}把每一天都当作最后一天来活！{/i}

lines.en: {i}And if you can not find the will to live, steal it from someone who can!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果找不到活下去的意志，那就从能找到的人那里偷过来！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Rin’s affection with Chika has increased to 1!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 与 Chika 的好感度提升到了 1!{/i}
